setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_POSITIONAL"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_POSITIONAL"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg NUMBER:=70; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER,v_extra NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg+v_extra AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value,3) LOOP total:=total+r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total*100+v_arg; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_NAMED"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_NAMED"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg NUMBER:=70; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER,v_extra NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg+v_extra AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(v_extra=>3,v_arg=>p_value) LOOP total:=total+r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total*100+v_arg; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_MIXED"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_MIXED"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg NUMBER:=70; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER,v_extra NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg+v_extra AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value,v_extra=>3) LOOP total:=total+r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total*100+v_arg; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_ACTUAL_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ACTUAL_SCOPE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg NUMBER:=70; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER,v_extra NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg+v_extra AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(v_arg+1,v_arg+2) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total*100+v_arg; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_REOPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_REOPEN"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v NUMBER; total NUMBER;CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN OPEN c(p_value); FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; total:=v; OPEN c(p_value+1); FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN total*100+v; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_SNAPSHOT"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_SNAPSHOT"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg NUMBER:=p_value; v NUMBER;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN OPEN c(v_arg); v_arg:=v_arg+10; FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN v*100+v_arg; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_COALESCE_REOPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_COALESCE_REOPEN"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS current_day DATE:=DATE '2002-07-03'; total NUMBER:=0; chosen VARCHAR2(20):='text';CURSOR c(x NUMBER,pp_date DATE) IS SELECT amount FROM "public"."BICDB_CP_K" WHERE category=x AND day>=pp_date AND COALESCE(amount,0)>=0 AND tag<>'excluded' ORDER BY day; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP FOR r IN c(p_value,current_day) LOOP SELECT COALESCE(chosen,'fallback') INTO chosen FROM DUAL; total:=total+COALESCE(r.amount,0); END LOOP; current_day:=current_day+1; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_BODY_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_BODY_SCOPE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v_arg VARCHAR2(20):='outside'; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER) IS SELECT v_arg AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP IF v_arg<>'outside' THEN RETURN -999; END IF; total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_QUALIFIED"

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_COLUMN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_COLUMN"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(v_arg NUMBER) IS SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount FROM "public"."BICDB_CP_T" WHERE v_arg=1; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_NESTED"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_NESTED"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR parent IN c(p_value) LOOP DECLARE CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT x+1 AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR child IN c(parent.amount) LOOP total:=child.amount; END LOOP; END; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_ERROR_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ERROR_SCOPE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS x VARCHAR2(20):='safe'; total NUMBER;CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT 10/(x-x) AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; RETURN LENGTH(x); END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_PRIOR_OPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_PRIOR_OPEN"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS v NUMBER;CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN OPEN c(p_value); BEGIN FOR r IN c(99) LOOP NULL; END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN v; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_ONCE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ONCE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS total NUMBER;CURSOR c(x NUMBER) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c("public"."BICDB_CP_SEQ".NEXTVAL) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_SCOPE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS chosen NUMBER:=70; total NUMBER;CURSOR c(x NUMBER DEFAULT 2,y NUMBER DEFAULT chosen) IS SELECT x+y AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_OPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_OPEN"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS chosen NUMBER:=p_value; total NUMBER:=0;CURSOR c(x NUMBER DEFAULT chosen) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN chosen:=p_value+2; FOR r IN c LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; chosen:=p_value+3; FOR r IN c() LOOP total:=total+r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_SKIP"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_DEFAULT_SKIP"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS CURSOR c(x NUMBER DEFAULT 1/0) IS SELECT x AS amount FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP RETURN r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN -999; END;

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_DATE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_DATE"(p_value NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS CURSOR c(x DATE) IS SELECT x AS chosen FROM DUAL; BEGIN FOR r IN c(TIMESTAMP '2024-02-29 12:34:56.999999') LOOP RETURN (r.chosen-TRUNC(r.chosen))*86400; END LOOP; RETURN -999; END;

setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ACTUAL_SCOPE"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE v_arg NUMERIC:=70; total NUMERIC:=0;c CURSOR (v_arg NUMERIC,v_extra NUMERIC) FOR SELECT v_arg+v_extra AS amount; BEGIN FOR r IN c(v_arg+1,v_arg+2) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total*100+v_arg; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_REOPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_REOPEN"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE v NUMERIC; total NUMERIC;c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT x AS amount; BEGIN OPEN c(p_value); FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; total:=v; OPEN c(p_value+1); FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN total*100+v; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_SNAPSHOT"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_SNAPSHOT"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE v_arg NUMERIC:=p_value; v NUMERIC;c CURSOR (v_arg NUMERIC) FOR SELECT v_arg AS amount; BEGIN OPEN c(v_arg); v_arg:=v_arg+10; FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN v*100+v_arg; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_COALESCE_REOPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_COALESCE_REOPEN"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE current_day DATE:=DATE '2002-07-03'; total NUMERIC:=0; chosen VARCHAR(20):='text';c CURSOR (x NUMERIC,pp_date DATE) FOR SELECT amount FROM "public"."BICDB_CP_K" WHERE category=x AND day>=pp_date AND COALESCE(amount,0)>=0 AND tag<>'excluded' ORDER BY day; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP FOR r IN c(p_value,current_day) LOOP SELECT COALESCE(chosen,'fallback') INTO chosen; total:=total+COALESCE(r.amount,0); END LOOP; current_day:=current_day+1; END LOOP; RETURN total; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_BODY_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_BODY_SCOPE"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE v_arg VARCHAR(20):='outside'; total NUMERIC:=0;c CURSOR (v_arg NUMERIC) FOR SELECT v_arg AS amount; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP IF v_arg<>'outside' THEN RETURN -999; END IF; total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_QUALIFIED"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_QUALIFIED"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT c.x AS amount; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP RETURN r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN -999; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_COLUMN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_COLUMN"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE total NUMERIC:=0;c CURSOR (v_arg NUMERIC) FOR SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount FROM "public"."BICDB_CP_T" WHERE v_arg=1; BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_NESTED"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_NESTED"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE total NUMERIC:=0;c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT x AS amount; BEGIN FOR parent IN c(p_value) LOOP DECLARE c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT x+1 AS amount; BEGIN FOR child IN c(parent.amount) LOOP total:=child.amount; END LOOP; END; END LOOP; RETURN total; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_ERROR_SCOPE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ERROR_SCOPE"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE x VARCHAR(20):='safe'; total NUMERIC;c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT 10/(x-x) AS amount; BEGIN BEGIN FOR r IN c(p_value) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; RETURN LENGTH(x); END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_PRIOR_OPEN"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_PRIOR_OPEN"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE v NUMERIC;c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT x AS amount; BEGIN OPEN c(p_value); BEGIN FOR r IN c(99) LOOP NULL; END LOOP; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; FETCH c INTO v; CLOSE c; RETURN v; END$$

setup.name: "public"."BICDB_CP_ONCE"
setup.sql: CREATE FUNCTION "public"."BICDB_CP_ONCE"(p_value NUMERIC) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE total NUMERIC;c CURSOR (x NUMERIC) FOR SELECT x AS amount; BEGIN FOR r IN c(nextval('"public"."BICDB_CP_SEQ"')) LOOP total:=r.amount; END LOOP; RETURN total; END$$
